## Pull request overview

This PR fixes a critical bug where dashboard configuration changes were not properly synchronized with the metadata cache after save operations. When users edited and saved dashboard widgets, closing the config panel would revert to stale cached data, requiring a full page refresh to see the changes.

**Changes:**
- Added `metadata.refresh()` calls after successful dashboard saves in both `DashboardView` and `DashboardDesignPage` to synchronize the cache
- Modified preview logic to keep edits visible after config panel closes (`editSchema || dashboard`) until metadata refreshes
- Added automatic cleanup of stale `editSchema` state when metadata refreshes while the config panel is closed
- Added 5 new tests verifying metadata refresh is called after widget save, delete, and Ctrl+S operations

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 6 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| apps/console/src/components/DashboardView.tsx | Added `refresh()` call in `saveSchema`, changed preview fallback to `editSchema \|\| dashboard`, added useEffect to clear stale editSchema when metadata updates, reset state on dashboard navigation |
| apps/console/src/pages/DashboardDesignPage.tsx | Added `refresh()` call after successful save to sync metadata cache |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/DashboardViewSelection.test.tsx | Added 2 tests verifying metadata refresh after widget config save and deletion |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/DashboardDesignPage.test.tsx | Added 2 tests verifying metadata refresh after onChange save and Ctrl+S save |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/DashboardDesignInteraction.test.tsx | Added 1 test verifying metadata refresh after widget deletion |
| ROADMAP.md | Documented Phase 11 completion with 6 fixes and 5 new tests |
</details>

Fire-and-forget pattern for metadata refresh is inconsistent with codebase conventions. Other similar operations in the codebase (CreateAppPage, EditAppPage, useNavigationSync, AppManagementPage) use `await refresh()` to ensure metadata is synchronized before continuing. The fire-and-forget pattern `refresh().catch(() => {})` could lead to race conditions where the UI displays stale data if the refresh hasn't completed when the user closes the config panel. Consider changing to `await refresh()` for consistent behavior.
```suggestion
          await refresh();
```

Fire-and-forget pattern for metadata refresh is inconsistent with codebase conventions. Other similar operations in the codebase (CreateAppPage.handleComplete line 61, EditAppPage.handleComplete line 70, useNavigationSync.saveApp line 166) use `await refresh()` to ensure metadata is synchronized before continuing. The fire-and-forget pattern could lead to race conditions. Consider changing to `await refresh()` for consistent behavior.
```suggestion
          await refresh();
```

The change from `configPanelOpen && editSchema ? editSchema : dashboard` to `editSchema || dashboard` means editSchema will be displayed even after the config panel is closed and before metadata refreshes. This could cause a race condition issue: if the metadata refresh fails (network error, server error), the user will continue seeing unsaved edits indefinitely in the preview, with no indication that the changes weren't persisted. Consider keeping the UI state synchronized with the actual backend state, or adding error handling to revert editSchema if the save/refresh fails.
```suggestion
  const previewSchema = configPanelOpen && editSchema ? editSchema : dashboard;
```
